interventions.detail: Used uv venv with Python 3.12 instead of conda (conda not available)
Installed torch/torchaudio 2.8.0 CPU wheels from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu since torch is not declared and default pulls CUDA build
apt install sox libsox-fmt-all libsndfile1 ffmpeg for python sox/soundfile
Load with device_map='cpu', dtype=float32 and no flash_attention_2 instead of README's cuda/bf16/flash-attn example
Pre-downloaded model and tokenizer via hf download into HF_HOME=/work/hf_cache exported in env.sh
